en.summary: Fibromyalgia involves widespread pain, fatigue, sleep problems and cognitive fog. NHS: diagnosis is clinical; management may include paced activity, sleep support, psychological therapies and sometimes medicines — this pack never invents doses. Seek urgent care for new chest pain, sudden weakness, or red-flag neuro symptoms (not typical fibromyalgia).
emergencyIf: Sudden chest pain, stroke-like symptoms, or severe unexplained fever
seeDoctorIf: Persistent widespread pain/fatigue affecting daily life
New or changing symptoms your GP should assess
doNot: Do not invent opioid or antidepressant regimens
Do not dismiss new red-flag symptoms as 'just fibro'

fr.summary: Fibromyalgie: douleurs diffuses, fatigue, sommeil. Orientation NHS; pas de posologies inventées. Urgences si signes cardio/neuro nouveaux.
emergencyIf: Douleur thoracique soudaine, signes d'AVC, fièvre grave

he.summary: פיברומיאלגיה: כאבים מפושטים, עייפות, שינה. לפי NHS; אין מינונים מומצאים. חירום לסימנים חדשים.
emergencyIf: כאב חזה פתאומי, סימני שבץ, חום קשה

ru.summary: Фибромиалгия: распространённые боли, усталость, сон. Ориентир NHS; дозы не выдумывать. Неотложка при новых красных флагах.
emergencyIf: Внезапная боль в груди, признаки инсульта, тяжёлая лихорадка
